subject: PO requirement amendment for pilot onboarding - OliveCloud
body:
From: Maria Torres <maria@olivecloud.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to move forward with the 6-week pilot. We are a small operations team and do not currently issue purchase orders for pilots. To keep things moving we wanted to ask whether Redwood can accept invoice-only billing for the pilot (SOW attached).

What we can provide immediately:
- Signed SOW (attached as OliveCloud_SOW_v2.docx)
- W9 (attached)
- PO might be available later in the year when our procurement cycle renews

Proposed terms: net30 invoicing against the SOW, reference Redwood deal OC-312. Pilot estimated total: $7,200.

Can your team route this without a PO, or is there a short exception process we should follow? Happy to provide additional vendor paperwork.

Thanks,
Maria Torres
Head of Ops | OliveCloud LLC
maria@olivecloud.io | +1 415-555-0132

----
From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: dev_patel@redwoodinference.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Maria Torres <maria@olivecloud.io>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Team — forwarding OliveCloud's request. Summary: small startup, pilot SOW attached, estimated spend ~ $7.2k, asking for invoice-only / no PO for the pilot. Attachments: OliveCloud_SOW_v2.docx, OliveCloud_W9.pdf.

Dev — can Finance accept invoice-only for this amount? If we need a one-off approval, what does the approval ladder look like?
Hannah — from Procurement, any objections on vendor risk / SLAs if we route them without a PO for 90 days?
Marissa — FYI on deal side: is the SOW final or do you want any changes?

Goal: respond to Maria today with a clear path and next steps so they can sign SOW and invoice.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

----
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:56:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Lauren / team — quick finance note. For small pilots sub-$10k we can route an invoice-only payout provided: 
1) We receive W9 and signed SOW referencing Redwood deal id (OC-312).
2) Vendor is set up in our AP system with a temporary vendor record and spending cap.
3) Invoice includes the accounting code and deal id; payment terms net30.

Operationally we'll need an approval from Procurement (Hannah) to bypass PO for up to 90 days. Finance can accept the invoice-only route and will create a temporary vendor ID (TEMP-OC312) once procurement signs off. Please request vendor to put "Invoice: OC-312" in the invoice body and send PDFs to ap@redwoodinference.com.

I recommend: conditional approval — Finance will pay net30 once documents are in and procurement enables the temporary vendor record. If spend exceeds $10k or pilot converts to committed contract, we must obtain a PO.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwoodinference.com

----
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 11:12:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Thanks — procurement perspective below.

Risk assessment summary: OliveCloud is a small vendor; pilot scope limited and capped at ~$7.2k. No prior Redwood relationship. Key asks/mitigations: 
- Require signed SOW with explicit termination clause (14-day termination for convenience) and liability cap limited to pilot fees.
- W9 collected (ok).
- One-time invoice-only allowance for 90 days; procurement will add the vendor to a monitored temporary vendor list and perform standard sanctions screening.
- If the vendor requests long-term credit terms or the account shows recurring billing, procurement will request a formal vendor onboarding (PO + supplier questionnaire).

Action items: 
- Marissa: confirm SOW final (if changes are minor we can accept SOW v2).
- Lauren: request that OliveCloud sign the SOW via DocuSign and send invoice PDFs to ap@redwoodinference.com with "OC-312" reference.
- Dev: once signed SOW & W9 received, Finance create TEMP-OC312 and route first invoice payment.

Procurement will document the exception and set a 90-day expiry. After 90 days, we either convert to PO or remove vendor. I attached a short template SOW addendum for the termination and liability language.

Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: procurement_sow_addendum_stub.docx (see drive link)

----
From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Maria Torres <maria@olivecloud.io>
Cc: dev_patel@redwoodinference.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Hi Maria — good news. We can do a short-term invoice-only onboarding to get the pilot started. Next steps and requirements: 

1) Sign SOW: Please sign the attached SOW (OliveCloud_SOW_v2.docx) via DocuSign using this link: https://app.docusign.com/OC-312/SOW. Procurement requests a short addendum (termination 14 days; liability cap to pilot fees) — Hannah has attached a template; please accept or propose language.
2) Provide W9: OliveCloud_W9.pdf received — thank you.
3) Invoice instructions: When invoicing, include "Invoice: OC-312" and send a PDF to ap@redwoodinference.com. Accounting code to use: 4001-PILOT. Payment terms: net30.
4) Temporary vendor record: Procurement & Finance will set up TEMP-OC312 and monitor spend. This exception is limited to 90 days or until cumulative spend >= $10k. If either threshold is reached we will require a PO and standard onboarding questionnaire.

If you can sign the SOW today we will enable the vendor record and clear the first invoice for payment. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

----
References:
- Attachments: OliveCloud_SOW_v2.docx (SOW draft), OliveCloud_W9.pdf (tax form)
- Procurement addendum stub: procurement_sow_addendum_stub.docx (internal template on Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzOliveCloudOnboard)
- DocuSign SOW link: https://app.docusign.com/OC-312/SOW
